job.builtinDescription: Built-in jobs are provided by the host or plugins and can only be reviewed here.
job.builtinReadonly: Built-in jobs cannot be modified in the form editor.
job.concurrencyHelp:
Singleton: if one instance is already running on the current node, new triggers are skipped.
Parallel: multiple instances can run on the current node, limited by Max Concurrency.
job.cronHelp:
Supports 5-part or 6-part Cron.
5-part expressions are parsed as minute hour day month week, and the runtime fills the seconds placeholder automatically.
6-part expressions can set seconds explicitly.
job.cronInvalidCount: Cron expressions must contain 5 or 6 parts.
job.cronSecondInvalid: The seconds field must be * or a value between 0 and 59.
job.envInvalid: Environment variables must be a valid JSON object.
job.environmentDisabled: Shell jobs are not enabled in the current environment
job.maxConcurrencyInvalid: Max Concurrency must be an integer between 1 and 100.
job.maxExecutionsHelp:
Limits the accumulated execution count that participates in execution counting.
Once the limit is reached, the job is disabled automatically and the stop reason is recorded.
Set to 0 to disable the limit; manual Run Now actions do not increase the count.
job.maxExecutionsInvalid: Max Executions must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.
job.name: Job Name
job.noShellPermission: The current account does not have permission to manage shell jobs
job.platformUnsupported: Shell jobs are not supported on the current platform
job.pluginPausedTooltip: This job depends on a handler provided by a plugin. When the plugin is disabled, uninstalled, or the handler is not registered, the system pauses the job automatically until the plugin becomes available again.
job.previewDescription: Review upcoming execution times before saving.
job.previewEmpty: Click Preview to load upcoming execution times.
job.previewFailed: Failed to preview upcoming execution times.
job.resetSuccess: The execution counter has been reset
job.retentionDaysSummary: Keep logs from the last {{value}} day(s)
job.retentionHelp:
Follow system: the job cleanup follows the system-level log retention policy.
Current system policy: {{currentPolicy}}.
If the job defines an override, the job-level policy takes precedence.
job.retentionValuePositive: Retention value must be greater than 0.
job.scopeHelp:
Primary Node Only: only the current primary node runs the job.
All Nodes: every online node runs the job once.
job.shellDescription: Configure the shell step. The runtime executes it with the current job context.
job.shellWarning: Shell tasks run commands on the host node. Review the command and environment variables carefully before saving.
job.timeoutHelp:
Maximum runtime allowed for a single job instance.
When the limit is exceeded, the system attempts to interrupt the execution and marks the execution log as timed out.
Leave some headroom above the normal runtime to avoid false positives.
job.timeoutInvalid: Timeout must be an integer between 1 and 86400.
job.timezoneInvalid: Please enter a valid timezone, for example Asia/Shanghai.
job.title: Scheduled Jobs

log.deleteAllHint: When selected, the date range is ignored and all execution logs in the current permission scope are deleted.
log.deleteRangeDescription: Select how to delete execution logs. By default, logs are cleaned by date range; selecting all logs cleans every execution log in the current permission scope.
log.deleteRangeRequired: Select a complete execution log date range
log.title: Execution Logs

plugins.autoEnableManagedHint: This plugin is managed by the host auto-enable policy. Manual changes may be reverted by the runtime during the next synchronization.
plugins.autoEnableRuntimeHint: {{actionLabel}} may only be temporary because the runtime can re-apply the host-managed auto-enable policy.
plugins.autoEnableUninstallHint: This plugin is managed by the host auto-enable policy. If it is synchronized again later, the runtime may reinstall or re-enable it according to host policy.

columnHelp.mockData: Yes means the plugin package includes optional sample data that can be loaded during installation; No means no sample data is available.
columnHelp.runtimeState: Runtime state shows whether the discovered package version matches the effective database version; Status shows whether the plugin is enabled.
columnHelp.supportsMultiTenant: Yes means the plugin supports multi-tenant governance, tenant-scoped installation, and tenant-side enablement; No means it is governed only as a platform-global capability.
columnHelp.tenantProvisioning: Controls whether a tenant-scoped plugin is enabled when a new tenant is created; it is configurable only for multi-tenant plugins installed in tenant-scoped mode.
columnHelp.type: Source plugins ship with the host source and build artifacts for trusted built-in capabilities; dynamic plugins are uploaded and switched as WASM artifacts for governed runtime installation, upgrades, and isolation.

plugins.dependencyRefreshFailed: Failed to refresh plugin dependency checks
plugins.detailScopeHint: The following scope reflects current plugin metadata and the authorization snapshot.
plugins.forceHint: Force uninstall bypasses the preconditions above and clears plugin data. Confirm that you understand the risk. Enter plugin ID "{{pluginId}}" to enable force uninstall.
plugins.frameworkUnsatisfied: The framework version does not satisfy the plugin requirement.
plugins.globalDescription: After platform installation, all tenants share the same enabled state.
plugins.installMockDataTooltip: When checked, the host loads the plugin's manifest/sql/mock-data SQL files in a single database transaction after the install SQL succeeds. Any failure rolls back only the sample data; the plugin install itself remains in effect. Sample data is intended for demos and feature validation, not production use.
plugins.installSucceededEnableFailed: Installed successfully, but enabling failed. Please review the authorization result and plugin status.
plugins.lifecyclePrecondition: A lifecycle precondition rejected this action.
plugins.listHelp: Only governable plugins are listed; host builtin plugins are excluded from ordinary lifecycle actions.
plugins.manualRepairHint: The discovered version is lower than the effective version and requires manual package repair.
plugins.name: Plugin Name
plugins.overwriteHint: Allow upload to overwrite an existing plugin package with the same ID and version.
plugins.platformOnlyGlobalHint: Plugins that do not support tenant-scoped installation can only be installed globally.
plugins.preconditionBlockedReason: The current plugin blocked this operation. Reason:

plugins.purgeWarning: Purged plugin-owned storage data cannot be recovered.
plugins.tenantPolicyEffective: This policy applies to subsequently created tenants.
